estilo.retrato: Rough expressive hand-inked sketch portrait, head and shoulders, scratchy ink and chalk strokes in rust-orange and off-white on a near-black textured background, like an inmate/staff file illustration from a gritty sci-fi prison sourcebook. No text, no border, no logo. Square composition, face centred.
estilo.icono: Bold single-subject pictogram icon, heavy black ink silhouette with a few flat red accents, rough screen-print texture, high contrast, centred with generous margin, on a plain flat off-white (#f3efe8) background. No text, no letters, no border, no frame.

imagenes.prompt: Stephen Bognar, 57, prison superintendent: genial, smiling, jovial heavyset man with a thick moustache, short grey hair, warm eyes that hide corruption, wearing a pressed uniform jacket with a small lapel pin.
Christof Bognar, 35, deputy superintendent: soft, nervous, sweaty man with slicked hair and a forced smirk, ill-fitting uniform, ambitious and petty, looks like he got the job from his uncle.

Kyou Aoki, 41, chief of correctional officers who joined the service to collect bribes: affable polite smile that never reaches cold calculating eyes, neat short hair, high-collar guard uniform with insignia.
Rani Kartall, 45, chief technician of a prison moon: South Asian woman with hair tied back, safety goggles pushed up on forehead, grease-stained work overalls, tired and competent.
Dr. Asad Sivert, 52, chief prison surgeon, ex-marine medic: weary bearded man with deep eye bags and a worn surgical cap, scrubs under a stained coat.
Rey Brun, 25, inmate and union man: broad-chested, easy affable smile worn like a mask, short hair, friendly open face with a hint of radicalised hardness in the eyes, patched prison jumpsuit.
Zazil Herbertsson, 43 but looks sixty-three: worn, sallow, sagging face, leering lecherous half-smile, thin greasy hair, prison jumpsuit with a nurse's smock collar.
